Name: iconnect S.A.S

Description:

As an independent and neutral partner, we have strong resources as well as deep industry experience that enables us to offer our clients flexible solutions with a wide range of options.

Name: Yoho Mobile
Description:
Yoho Mobile makes global travel connectivity simple with easy-to-use eSIM solutions. We help travelers, digital nomads, and businesses stay connected abroad without physical SIM cards, expensive roaming fees, or complicated setup.

Through our app and web platform, users can quickly choose data plans, activate eSIMs, top up when needed, and manage connectivity across destinations worldwide.

Our mission is to make staying connected anywhere as effortless as turning on your phone.
